profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at LinkedIn
profile.summary: Software developing professional with relevant experience in the industry. Strong reputation for being a team player, great communication skills, flexibility in learning new skills, and quick turn-around time in projects.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently working as part of the anti-abuse team to prevent, detect, and react to misuse of the LinkedIn platform. We protect member's accounts from compromises and detect impersonators and other fake accounts from the platform at a massive scale

positions.title: Specialist Developer
positions.description:
• Became full-stack main developer on a web portal with a microservices architecture designed to assist other employees with onboarding and tracking of plugins and APIs on BNY Mellon’s financial services platform
• Prototyped a chatbot creation interface using an Angular frontend to input training data, trigger training, and interact with the trained chatbot. The model was trained using the RASA library
• Created functionality and load testing scripts using Apache JMeter
• Selected to be a member of a national level team to assist an effort to move applications from an old system to an inhouse IaaS/PaaS cloud environment. Received Ansible and Chocolatey training as part of this effort

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Rebuilt the CSE department website by adding missing content, updating outdated pages, and modernizing its style
• Reproduced work on an Iris Spoofing Detection system using BSIF feature extraction to train an ensemble prediction model with the help of the Weka library

company.name: University of Notre Dame CSE Department

positions.title: Research Assitant
positions.description: Implemented a workstation designed to fly multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) using a multithreaded solution with a consumer/producer design

certifications.name: Confronting Bias: Thriving Across Our Differences
certifications.title: Confronting Bias: Thriving Across Our Differences

projects.title: Student Processes Tracking Database (Python)
projects.description: Project consisted on recording processes on 3 remote machines used by Notre Dame computer science students. The data was collected in a MySQL database to perform statistical analytics. A website was created to display our results. The website was run on an Apache server using PHP for backend tasks. The website displayed important analytics by class (favorite language, favorite editor, etc) using the D3 visualization library. Website also featured student leaderboards and a student search feature.

projects.title: Pacman with Online Multiplayer (Python)
projects.description: Recreated Pacman using Pygame library and added online multiplayer functionality using the Twisted library. In multiplayer mode, the other users could take control of the ghosts chasing Pacman.
